newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to suspend, move to delist He-Ro.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to suspend, move to delist He-Ro.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday it will suspend trading in the common stock of the He-Ro Group Ltd on July 21 prior to delisting because the company falls below the exchange's listing criteria.
The exchange said He-Ro is trying to transfer the trading in its stock to another marketplace.
The exchange said it may suspend trading in He-Ro earlier if the company starts trading on another securities market or if it fails to meet the listing requirements of that other market.
The exchange said it will apply to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist He-Ro shares following the suspension in trading.

The He-Ro Group said March 12 a group of investors would invest $7 million in the company in exchange for 80 percent of its common stock. The maker of ladies evening and special occasion wear named Oleg Cassini, Oleg Cassini Inc and Stonehill Investment Corp as the investors.
The company said it would be renamed Oleg Cassini Group International Ltd, with Cassini as its new chairman.
A company official was not immediately available for comment.
He-Ro's shares closed at 7/8 Thursday, down 1/16.

The New York Exchange said it requires companies to have $12 million of net tangible assets available to its common stock; an average $600,000 net income for the last three years; an $12 million aggregate market value of its common stock; and an $8 million aggregate market value of its publicly-held shares.
